breakdown.description: Counterflow configuration is stated but the parallel-flow LMTD temperature differences are used.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the user provided the temperature differences for a parallel-flow configuration (ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,in and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,out) despite asking for a counterflow heat exchanger. The agent corrected this by specifying the correct temperature differences for a counterflow configuration: ΔT1 = Th,in - Tc,out and ΔT2 = Th,out - Tc,in, which matches the ground truth.
